name: Can☆Fes! ~Itazura Majo to Naisho no Gakuensai~
original_name: きゃん☆フェス！～いたずら魔女とナイショの学園祭～
source:
When the protagonist was small, he took care of a lost witch who would not show her anger even if she was teased. She didn't talk much, but occasionally said “If I get my powers back…” One day she disappeared. Ten years later, the witch Prim comes back and declares that he will now be her servant!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
主人公小时候曾照顾过一名迷路的魔女。即使受到捉弄，她也从不发火。她沉默寡言，只是偶尔会说：‘如果我恢复力量…’某天，她突然消失。十年后，魔女普莉姆再次出现，并宣布从今以后，主人公就是她的仆人！

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
